# ============================================================================
#  Makefile - Design Compiler (DC) synthesis flow
#  Top design : cfreq_ctrl
# ============================================================================

SHELL        := /bin/bash

# ---- flow root (directory containing this Makefile) ------------------------
SYN_ROOT     := $(abspath $(dir $(lastword $(MAKEFILE_LIST))))

# ---- design info -----------------------------------------------------------
DESIGN_NAME  := cfreq_ctrl

# ---- tool & directories ----------------------------------------------------
DC_SHELL      ?= $(DC_HOME)/bin/dc_shell
DC_FLAGS       = -64bit

SCRIPTS       = $(SYN_ROOT)/scripts
SETUP         = $(SYN_ROOT)/setup
SDC           = $(SYN_ROOT)/sdc
DATA          = $(SYN_ROOT)/data
REPORTS       = $(SYN_ROOT)/reports
RESULTS       = $(SYN_ROOT)/results
LOG           = $(SYN_ROOT)/log

DC_SCRIPT     = $(SCRIPTS)/dc.tcl

.PHONY: all syn compile clean help dirs

all: syn

dirs:
	@mkdir -p $(REPORTS) $(RESULTS) $(LOG)

syn: dirs
	@echo "=============================================================="
	@echo " Running Design Compiler synthesis for $(DESIGN_NAME)"
	@echo "=============================================================="
	cd $(SYN_ROOT) && \
	$(DC_SHELL) $(DC_FLAGS) \
		-f $(DC_SCRIPT) \
		-output_log_file $(LOG)/$(DESIGN_NAME).dc.log | \
		tee $(LOG)/$(DESIGN_NAME).dc.console.log

clean:
	@rm -rf $(REPORTS) $(RESULTS) $(LOG) *.log *.svf

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all | syn   - run DC synthesis flow"
	@echo "  clean       - remove generated reports/results/logs"
	@echo
	@echo "Environment (override as needed):"
	@echo "  DC_HOME     - Design Compiler installation root"
```

```makefile
#===============================================================================
# Makefile - Design Compiler synthesis flow for cfreq_ctrl
#
# Usage:
#   make            # run the complete synthesis flow (default target)
#   make syn        # alias of "all"
#   make clean      # remove all generated reports / results / logs
#
# Required environment (external):
#   DC_HOME         : Design Compiler installation root (or set DC_SHELL directly)
#   LIB_PATH        : Liberty (.db) library search path (overridable)
#   TARGET_LIB      : target Liberty library file (overridable)
#===============================================================================

SHELL        := /bin/bash

# Flow root = directory containing this Makefile
SYN_ROOT     := $(abspath $(dir $(lastword $(MAKEFILE_LIST))))

# Design top
DESIGN_NAME  := cfreq_ctrl

# Tool
DC_SHELL     ?= $(DC_HOME)/bin/dc_shell
DC_FLAGS      = -64bit -no_gui

# Sub-directories
SCRIPTS       = $(SYN_ROOT)/scripts
SETUP         = $(SYN_ROOT)/setup
SDC           = $(SYN_ROOT)/sdc
DATA          = $(SYN_ROOT)/data
REPORTS       = $(SYN_ROOT)/reports
RESULTS       = $(SYN_ROOT)/results
LOG           = $(SYN_ROOT)/log

DC_SCRIPT     = $(SCRIPTS)/dc.tcl

.PHONY: all syn clean help dirs

all: syn

dirs:
	@mkdir -p $(REPORTS) $(RESULTS) $(LOG)

## Run the synthesis flow from the flow root so that all Tcl relative paths resolve.
syn: dirs
	@echo "==================================================================="
	@echo "=  Design Compiler : synthesis for $(DESIGN_NAME)"
	@echo "==================================================================="
	cd $(SYN_ROOT) && \
	$(DC_SHELL) $(DC_FLAGS) \
		-f $(DC_SCRIPT) \
		-output_log_file $(LOG)/$(DESIGN_NAME).dc.log \
		| tee $(LOG)/$(DESIGN_NAME).console.log

clean:
	@rm -rf $(REPORTS) $(RESULTS) $(LOG) *.log

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all | syn   run the DC synthesis flow"
	@echo "  clean       remove generated reports/results/logs"
	@echo ""
	@echo "Environment (override via 'export' before make):"
	@echo "  DC_HOME     Design Compiler installation root"
	@echo "  LIB_PATH    Liberty library search path"
	@echo "  TARGET_LIB  target Liberty library file (.db)"
```

```tcl
#===============================================================================
# cfreq_ctrl.sdc - timing constraints for Design Compiler synthesis
#
# Design top : cfreq_ctrl
# Clocks     : REFCLK (25 MHz reference clock, 40 ns)
#              FBCLK  (VCO feedback clock, ~25 MHz target, asynchronous to REFCLK)
# Reset      : RST_N (asynchronous, active low, synchronously released)
#===============================================================================

# ---- clocks -------------------------------------------------------------------
# REFCLK : 25 MHz - 100 MHz reference. Use 40 ns (25 MHz) as the timing target.
create_clock -name REFCLK -period 40.0 -waveform {0.0 20.0} [get_ports REFCLK]
# FBCLK : VCO output divided down to ~25 MHz target.
create_clock -name FBCLK  -period 40.0 -waveform {0.0 20.0} [get_ports FBCLK]

# ---- asynchronous clock domains -------------------------------------------------
# REFCLK and FBCLK are generated from independent sources (VCO); CDC crossings are
# handled by 2-FF synchronizers. Declare them asynchronous so STA does not
# enumerate timing paths across the domains.
set_clock_groups -asynchronous \
    -group [get_clocks REFCLK] \
    -group [get_clocks FBCLK]

# ---- asynchronous reset ---------------------------------------------------------
# RST_N is an asynchronous active-low reset; no data-path timing is checked to it.
set_false_path -from [get_ports RST_N]
set_false_path -to   [get_ports RST_N]

# ---- input timing (relative to REFCLK) -------------------------------------------
# WINDOW_LEN / THRESHOLD / LOOP_BREAK are configuration/control inputs that are
# consumed in the REFCLK clock domain.
set_input_delay -clock REFCLK -max 2.0 [get_ports {WINDOW_LEN THRESHOLD LOOP_BREAK}]
set_input_delay -clock REFCLK -min 0.5 [get_ports {WINDOW_LEN THRESHOLD LOOP_BREAK}]

# FB_DCLK inputs in FBCLK domain? None (FBCLK domain has no data input ports).

# ---- output timing (relative to REFCLK) --------------------------------------------
set_output_delay -clock REFCLK -max 2.0 [get_ports {RDY CAP_CTRL_OUT}]
set_output_delay -clock REFCLK -min 0.5 [get_ports {RDY CAP_CTRL_OUT}]

# ---- environment -------------------------------------------------------------------
set_input_transition 0.1 [remove_from_collection [all_inputs] [get_ports {REFCLK FBCLK RST_N}]]
set_load 0.05 [all_outputs]

# ---- CDC safety (explicit, in addition to set_clock_groups) ---------------------------
# gate  : REFCLK -> FBCLK  (synchronized by gate_sync_meta/gate_sync 2-FF)
# fb_cnt: FBCLK  -> REFCLK (latched by fb_cnt_latch after gate closes; value is stable)
# These paths are already masked by the asynchronous clock groups; keep the
# constraint file conservative and rely on set_clock_groups above.

# cfreq_ctrl — Design Compiler Synthesis Flow

This directory contains a complete Synopsys Design Compiler (`dc_shell`, Tcl
mode) synthesis flow for the `cfreq_ctrl` VCO auto-calibration module.

- **Top module** : `cfreq_ctrl`
- **Target RTL** : `assets/rtl_synth/cfreq_ctrl.v`

## Directory layout

```
syn/
├── Makefile                 # build driver (all / syn / clean)
├── SourceMe                 # shell environment setup (source this first)
├── README.md                # this file
├── setup/
│   └── common_setup.tcl     # flow root, design name, library variables
├── scripts/
│   ├── dc.tcl               # top-level synthesis script
│   ├── dc_setup.tcl         # applies libraries / search path
│   └── dc_setup_filenames.tcl # design-specific file names
├── sdc/
│   └── cfreq_ctrl.sdc       # timing constraints
└── data/
    └── syn_filelist.f       # RTL source file list
```

## Quick start

```bash
source ./SourceMe          # set DC_HOME / LIB_PATH / TARGET_LIB / RTL_ROOT
make                       # or: make syn
```

Results are written to `reports/`, `results/` and `log/`:

- `results/cfreq_ctrl.vg`  : mapped (gate-level) Verilog netlist
- `results/cfreq_ctrl.ddc` : compiled design for re-loading
- `reports/*.rpt`          : area / timing / power / QoR / DRC reports

## Environment variables

| Variable    | Meaning                                          |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `DC_HOME`   | Design Compiler installation root                |
| `DC_SHELL`  | Full path to `dc_shell` (optional override)      |
| `LIB_PATH`  | Liberty (`.db`) search path                      |
| `TARGET_LIB`| Target liberty file used for mapping             |
| `RTL_ROOT`  | Directory that contains `assets/rtl_synth`       |

## Flow description

1. `dc_setup.tcl` sources `common_setup.tcl`, then applies the liberty
   libraries, `search_path`, `target_library`, `link_library` and
   `synthetic_library`.
2. `dc_setup_filenames.tcl` defines the design-specific file names.
3. `dc.tcl` reads the RTL file list (`data/syn_filelist.f`), elaborates and
   links `cfreq_ctrl`, reads the SDC constraints (`sdc/cfreq_ctrl.sdc`),
   compiles, reports QoR/timing/area/power/DRC, and writes the gate-level
   netlist and `.ddc`.

Paths inside `data/syn_filelist.f` are relative to `RTL_ROOT` (by default the
parent of this `syn/` directory, i.e. the repository root that contains
`assets/rtl_synth`). Override `RTL_ROOT` if the RTL source tree is elsewhere.

#
# Flow:
#   1. library / search path setup
#   2. design-specific file names
#   3. read RTL (from data/syn_filelist.f)

#===============================================================================

puts "=================================================================="
puts " DC synthesis flow started : [clock format [clock seconds]]"
puts "=================================================================="

# ---- resolve flow root -----------------------------------------------------------
if {![info exists env(SYN_ROOT)]} {
    set SYN_ROOT [file normalize [file dirname [file dirname [info script]]]]
} else {
    set SYN_ROOT [file normalize $env(SYN_ROOT)]
}

set REPORTS_DIR ${SYN_ROOT}/reports
set RESULTS_DIR ${SYN_ROOT}/results

source -echo -verbose ${SCRIPTS_DIR}/dc_setup_filenames.tcl

# Record the automation for later formality usage
set_svf $SVFFILE

# ---- 2. read RTL -------------------------------------------------------------------
puts "INFO : reading RTL from ${RTL_FILELIST}"
set rtl_files {}
set fp [open $RTL_FILELIST r]
while {[gets $fp line] >= 0} {
    set line [string trim $line]
    if {$line eq ""}                    { continue }

link
uniquify

read_sdc ${SDC_FILE}

#===============================================================================
# cfreq_ctrl.sdc - timing constraints for Design Compiler synthesis
#
# Design top : cfreq_ctrl (VCO auto-calibration module)
# Clocks     : REFCLK  25 MHz reference clock (40 ns period)
#              FBCLK   VCO feedback clock, target ~25 MHz (40 ns), async to REFCLK
# Reset      : RST_N  asynchronous, active low, synchronously released
#===============================================================================

# ---- clocks -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REFCLK : 25 MHz - 100 MHz reference clock. Use 40 ns (25 MHz) as timing target.
create_clock -name REFCLK -period 40.0 -waveform {0.0 20.0} [get_ports REFCLK]
# FBCLK : VCO output divided down to ~25 MHz target.
create_clock -name FBCLK  -period 40.0 -waveform {0.0 20.0} [get_ports FBCLK]

# ---- asynchronous clock domains ------------------------------------------------------
# REFCLK and FBCLK come from independent sources (the VCO is not phase-related to
# REFCLK); CDC crossings are handled by synchronizers. Declare the domains
# asynchronous so STA does not enumerate timing paths across them.
set_clock_groups -asynchronous \
    -group [get_clocks REFCLK] \
    -group [get_clocks FBCLK]

# ---- asynchronous reset ---------------------------------------------------------------
# RST_N is an asynchronous active-low reset; no data-path timing is checked to/from it
# (recovery/removal is checked automatically on the async reset pins).
set_false_path -from [get_ports RST_N]
set_false_path -to   [get_ports RST_N]

# ---- input timing (relative to REFCLK) --------------------------------------------------
# WINDOW_LEN / THRESHOLD / LOOP_BREAK are configuration/control inputs consumed in the
# REFCLK clock domain.
set_input_delay -clock REFCLK -max 2.0 [get_ports {WINDOW_LEN THRESHOLD LOOP_BREAK}]
set_input_delay -clock REFCLK -min 0.5 [get_ports {WINDOW_LEN THRESHOLD LOOP_BREAK}]

# The FBCLK clock domain has no data input ports (only FBCLK itself); the counter is
# driven by the synchronized "gate" that originates in the REFCLK domain.

# ---- output timing (relative to REFCLK) ---------------------------------------------------
set_output_delay -clock REFCLK -max 2.0 [get_ports {RDY CAP_CTRL_OUT}]
set_output_delay -clock REFCLK -min 0.5 [get_ports {RDY CAP_CTRL_OUT}]

# ---- environment ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
set_input_transition 0.1 [remove_from_collection [all_inputs] [get_ports {REFCLK FBCLK RST_N}]]
set_load 0.05 [all_outputs]
